Question: Emmy says to Max, “I ordered \(36\) math club sweatshirts today.” Max asks, “How much did each shirt cost?” Emmy responds, “I’ll give you a hint. The total cost was \(\$\underline{A}\,\underline{B}\,\underline{B}.\underline{B}\,\underline{A},\) where \(A\) and \(B\) are digits and \(A \neq 0.\)” After a pause, Max says, “That was a good price.” What is \(A + B?\)
